72: @HandlerPriority(66560) // 2^16 + 2^10; we must run AFTER HandleVal which is at 2^16
73: public class HandleExtensionMethod extends JavacAnnotationHandler<ExtensionMethod> {
74: 	@Override
75: 	public void handle(final AnnotationValues<ExtensionMethod> annotation, final JCAnnotation source, final JavacNode annotationNode) {
76: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.EXTENSION_METHOD_FLAG_USAGE, "@ExtensionMethod");
77: 		
78: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, ExtensionMethod.class);
79: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
80: 		boolean isClassOrEnumOrInterface = isClassOrEnumOrInterface(typeNode);
81: 		
82: 		if (!isClassOrEnumOrInterface) {
83: 			annotationNode.addError("@ExtensionMethod can only be used on a class or an enum or an interface");
84: 			return;
85: 		}
86: 		
87: 		boolean suppressBaseMethods = annotation.getInstance().suppressBaseMethods();
88: 		
89: 		List<Object> extensionProviders = annotation.getActualExpressions("value");
90: 		if (extensionProviders.isEmpty()) {
91: 			annotationNode.addError(String.format("@%s has no effect since no extension types were specified.", ExtensionMethod.class.getName()));
92: 			return;
93: 		}
94: 		final List<Extension> extensions = getExtensions(annotationNode, extensionProviders);
95: 		if (extensions.isEmpty()) return;
96: 		
97: 		new ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(annotationNode, extensions, suppressBaseMethods).replace();
98: 		
99: 		annotationNode.rebuild();
100: 	}

102: 	
103: 	public List<Extension> getExtensions(final JavacNode typeNode, final List<Object> extensionProviders) {
104: 		List<Extension> extensions = new ArrayList<Extension>();
105: 		for (Object extensionProvider : extensionProviders) {
106: 			if (!(extensionProvider instanceof JCFieldAccess)) continue;
107: 			JCFieldAccess provider = (JCFieldAccess) extensionProvider;
108: 			if (!("class".equals(provider.name.toString()))) continue;
109: 			Type providerType = CLASS.resolveMember(typeNode, provider.selected);
110: 			if (providerType == null) continue;
111: 			if ((providerType.tsym.flags() & (INTERFACE | ANNOTATION)) != 0) continue;
112: 			
113: 			extensions.add(getExtension(typeNode, (ClassType) providerType));
114: 		}
115: 		return extensions;
116: 	}

118: 	public boolean isClassOrEnumOrInterface(JavacNode typeNode) {
119: 		if (typeNode == null) return false;
120: 
121: 		JavacAST ast = typeNode.getAst();
122: 		JCTree rawNode = typeNode.get();
123: 		if (ast == null || rawNode == null) return false;
124: 		if (typeNode.getKind() != Kind.TYPE) return false;
125: 
126: 		JavacTreeMaker maker = ast.getTreeMaker();
127: 		boolean hasTrees = this.trees != null;
128: 		boolean hasContext = ast.getContext() != null;
129: 		boolean hasSymbols = ast.getSymbolTable() != null;
130: 		boolean hasMaker = maker != null && maker.getUnderlyingTreeMaker() != null;
131: 		if (!hasTrees && !hasContext && !hasSymbols && !hasMaker) return false;
132: 
133: 		JavacNode parent = typeNode.directUp();
134: 		boolean hasFile = ast.getFileName() != null;
135: 		boolean hasPackage = ast.getPackageDeclaration() != null;
136: 		boolean hasImports = ast.getImportList() != null;
137: 		boolean hasTop = ast.top() != null;
138: 		boolean hasParent = parent != null;
139: 		boolean javaLangObjectKnown = ast.getImportListAsTypeResolver().typeMatches(typeNode, "java.lang.Object", "Object");
140: 		if (!hasFile && !hasPackage && !hasImports && !hasTop && !hasParent && !javaLangObjectKnown) return false;
141: 
142: 		return isClassAndDoesNotHaveFlags(typeNode, ANNOTATION | Javac.RECORD);
143: 	}

145: 	public Extension getExtension(final JavacNode typeNode, final ClassType extensionMethodProviderType) {
146: 		List<MethodSymbol> extensionMethods = new ArrayList<MethodSymbol>();
147: 		JavacNode hostType = typeNode.up();
148: 		if (hostType != null && !isClassOrEnumOrInterface(hostType)) {
149: 			return new Extension(extensionMethods, extensionMethodProviderType.asElement());
150: 		}
151: 		TypeSymbol tsym = extensionMethodProviderType.asElement();
152: 		if (tsym != null) for (Symbol member : tsym.getEnclosedElements()) {
153: 			if (member.getKind() != ElementKind.METHOD) continue;

158: 		}
159: 		return new Extension(extensionMethods, tsym);

164: 		final TypeSymbol extensionProvider;

168: 			this.extensionProvider = extensionProvider;
169: 		}

173: 		final JavacNode annotationNode;
174: 		final List<Extension> extensions;
175: 		final boolean suppressBaseMethods;
176: 		
177: 		public ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(JavacNode annotationNode, List<Extension> extensions, boolean suppressBaseMethods) {
178: 			this.annotationNode = annotationNode;
179: 			this.extensions = extensions;
180: 			this.suppressBaseMethods = suppressBaseMethods;
181: 		}
182: 		
183: 		public void replace() {
184: 			annotationNode.up().get().accept(this, null);
185: 		}

191: 			return null;
192: 		}

194: 		private void handleMethodCall(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
195: 			JavacNode methodCallNode = annotationNode.getAst().get(methodCall);
196: 			
197: 			if (methodCallNode == null) {
198: 				// This should mean the node does not exist in the source at all. This is the case for generated nodes, such as implicit super() calls.
199: 				return;
200: 			}
201: 			
202: 			JavacNode surroundingType = upToTypeNode(methodCallNode);
203: 			
204: 			TypeSymbol surroundingTypeSymbol = ((JCClassDecl)surroundingType.get()).sym;
205: 			JCExpression receiver = receiverOf(methodCall);
206: 			String methodName = methodNameOf(methodCall);
207: 			
208: 			if ("this".equals(receiver.toString()) || "this".equals(methodName) || "super".equals(methodName)) return;

210: 			
211: 			JCTree resolvedMethodCall = resolution.get(methodCall);
212: 			if (resolvedMethodCall == null || resolvedMethodCall.type == null) return;
213: 			if (!suppressBaseMethods && !(resolvedMethodCall.type instanceof ErrorType)) return;
214: 			
215: 			JCTree resolvedReceiver = resolution.get(receiver);
216: 			if (resolvedReceiver == null || resolvedReceiver.type == null) return;
217: 			Type receiverType = resolvedReceiver.type;
218: 			
219: 			// Skip static method access
220: 			Symbol sym = null;
221: 			if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCIdent) {
222: 				sym = ((JCIdent) resolvedReceiver).sym;
223: 			} else if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
224: 				sym = ((JCFieldAccess) resolvedReceiver).sym;
225: 			}
226: 			if (sym instanceof ClassSymbol) return;
227: 			
228: 			Types types = Types.instance(annotationNode.getContext());
229: 			for (Extension extension : extensions) {
230: 				TypeSymbol extensionProvider = extension.extensionProvider;
231: 				if (surroundingTypeSymbol == extensionProvider) continue;
232: 				for (MethodSymbol extensionMethod : extension.extensionMethods) {
233: 					if (!methodName.equals(extensionMethod.name.toString())) continue;
234: 					Type extensionMethodType = extensionMethod.type;
235: 					if (!MethodType.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType) && !ForAll.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType)) continue;
236: 					Type firstArgType = types.erasure(extensionMethodType.asMethodType().argtypes.get(0));
237: 					if (!types.isAssignable(receiverType, firstArgType)) continue;
238: 					methodCall.args = methodCall.args.prepend(receiver);
239: 					methodCall.meth = chainDotsString(annotationNode, extensionProvider.toString() + "." + methodName);
240: 					recursiveSetGeneratedBy(methodCall.meth, methodCallNode);
241: 					return;
242: 				}
243: 			}
244: 		}
245: 		
246: 		private String methodNameOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
247: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
248: 				return ((JCIdent) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
249: 			} else {
250: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
251: 			}
252: 		}
253: 		
254: 		private JCExpression receiverOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
255: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
256: 				return annotationNode.getTreeMaker().Ident(annotationNode.toName("this"));
257: 			} else {
258: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).selected;
259: 			}
260: 		}
261: 	}

The fix is complete and validated. Summary of changes in `src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleExtensionMethod.java`:

**Root cause:** `getExtension` used `(method.flags() & (STATIC | PUBLIC)) == 0`, which only rejects methods with *neither* flag — so public **instance** methods of extension providers (e.g. `String.startsWith`) were collected as extension methods. `"foo".startsWith("f")` then got rewritten into a call with the receiver prepended as an argument, producing the `String cannot be converted to int` error.

**Fix:**
1. Require both `STATIC` and `PUBLIC` independently when collecting extension methods.
2. Collect extension method names up front and skip method calls whose name matches nothing (`names.contains` check), so unrelated calls are never resolved/transformed.
3. Scan type arguments/method select before handling the call and arguments after, plus bail out on erroneous receiver types.

**Validation:** the issue's reproduction now compiles cleanly, extension behavior still works (chained/`or`/`toTitleCase`/autoboxing cases), and the full `ant test` suite passes — 1006 tests, 0 failures, including all ExtensionMethod delombok/ecj/javac cases.
